about_the_game:
My Little Farm is a first-person farming simulator built in Unreal Engine 5, where every drop of water, every harvest, and every motion feels real.
Relax into a world of light, color, and physics-driven satisfaction as you grow, harvest, and haul your crops by hand.

🌾 Grow. Harvest. Stack.
Water vibrant crops that glisten in the sunlight. Watch them sway in the wind, bloom with color, and react naturally to your touch. Then harvest them with satisfying, physics-based animations that make every pull, cut, and toss feel rewarding.

🥕 A Tactile Farming Experience
No menus, no abstraction — just hands-on, first-person farming. Feel the weight of every harvest as you stack your crops in your arms and carry them to the barn, balancing each load with realistic motion.

☀️ Built for Beauty
Powered by Unreal Engine 5, every scene glows with cinematic realism — soft sunlight through leaves, glistening water droplets, and detailed crop physics that make this the most immersive farming sim yet.

🎥 Made to Be Satisfying
Each moment is designed to look and feel incredible. Whether you’re watering, harvesting, or stacking, every action flows into the next — perfect for cozy, ASMR-style clips or short-form viral moments.

🧺 Features

  • Realistic Farming Physics: Pick up, water, and harvest your crops in full first-person 3D.

  • Satisfying Visual Feedback: Watch plants grow, react, and tumble with lifelike motion.

  • Immersive Audio & Lighting: Hear the rain, feel the soil, and watch the sun move across your fields.

  • Relaxing Gameplay Loop: No timers, no pressure, just the joy of tending and harvesting at your own pace.

Step into a world where farming isn’t about management, it’s about feeling.
The field is waiting. Will you answer the call of the harvest?

  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 620
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
